defs.def: to be different from each other in size, shape, etc. 一组类似的事物

ex.t: 数字读数为什么会有差异。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: The snow was marked only by small animals: foxes, coyotes, mice, and varying hares, which turned white in the winter.”
ex.t: 雪地上只有小动物留下的痕迹：狐狸、土狼、老鼠，以及冬天会变成白色的雪鞋兔。

ex.s: The qualities of time vary with how you measure it．
ex.t: 时间的品质因测量方式而异．

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略并非只是好高骛远，当他从比萨斜塔扔下重量不同的物体并计时它们落地时。

ex.s: Typing patterns vary from person to person.
In the past, money's makeup varied from place to place, depending on what was considered valuable there.
ex.t: 在西非，青铜或铜手镯被用作现金，特别是如果交易与那里的奴隶贸易有关的话。

ex.s: But as life continues, we’re presented with more varied experiences: starting university, getting a job and raising a family.
ex.t: 但随着生活继续，我们会遇到更多样化的经历：上大学、找工作、养家。

ex.s: Valuable Values The spending power of young people varies from person to person.
ex.t: 宝贵的价值观　年轻人的消费能力因人而异。

ex.s: Their designs were admirable, varying from grand buildings to public works, such as roads and dams.
ex.t: 他们的设计令人赞叹，从宏伟建筑到道路、水坝等公共工程，各不相同。

ex.s: This could vary from a view of a pond and the splashing of fish, to a tree in blossom, a pagoda or a moon-shaped gate.
ex.t: 这可能是从池塘的景色和鱼儿溅水的声音，到一棵花开满枝的树、一座塔或一个月亮形的大门。

defs.def: to change or be different according to the situation （根据情况）变化，变更，改变

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 道德美德在各文化间的相似性令人惊叹，尽管这些美德的相对排序可能随社会群体的历史和环境而变化。

ex.s: In fact, the methods of science have varied between disciplines and across time.
ex.t: 事实上，科学的方法在不同学科和不同时期都有所不同。

ex.s: Ocean colour varies from green to blue，depending on the type and concentration of phytoplankton.
ex.t: 海水的颜色因浮游植物的种类和浓度不同，而从绿色到蓝色变化。

ex.s: adaptation is an ever-changing processB. the cost of adaptation varies with time
ex.t: 适应是一个不断变化的过程B. 适应的成本随时间变化

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

defs.def: to make changes to sth to make it slightly different （略为）变更，改变

ex.s: Why did they vary ever so slightly from one instrument to the next?
ex.t: 为什么它们在不同乐器之间会有如此微小的差异？
